身处下界传送门内时自动朝脚下掷出末影珍珠，快速脱离传送门。: Throws an ender pearl when inside nether portals
点击方块即改为包挖掘：后台按最优工具计算进度，配 Grim 诱饵与重试确认，到阈: Packet mines the clicked block at best-tool speed behind a Grim decoy, then rebreaks it.
借助包挖掘清理周围所有可破坏方块，可按范围、形状与方块类型过滤。: Breaks all blocks around you through PacketMine. Requires PacketMine.
边走边在脚下自动放置方块搭路，带速度前瞻与下探深度，不发送转向。: Places blocks beneath you as you walk, through the PlacementManager. No rotations.
管理 HUD 模块列表的手动关注项: Manages the optional ActiveModules HUD watchlist
为模块设置快捷键: Sets a key bind for a module
本机性能诊断：start [1-60 秒] 或 stop、status、expo: Local performance diagnostics: start [1-60 seconds] | stop | status | export. No upload.
生成一个仅本机可见的假人以供测试: Spawns a client-side fake player to test on
开关 ClickGui 中趣味分类的显示: Toggles visibility of the Funny category in the ClickGui
列出全部可用命令与说明: Displays all executable commands and additional information
保存套装并执行套装补给: Saves kits and runs KitReplenish resupply passes
选择一键补装使用的套装: Selects which saved kit InstantRekit will apply
把当前背包保存为命名的一键补装套装: Snapshots your current inventory as a named InstantRekit kit
本机耗时统计：.timings [前N] 查看留存数据；.timings res: Inclusive local timings: .timings [topN] reads retained data; .timings reset starts a fresh 60s window.
管理路径点：增删查改；coords 显示下界与主世界坐标换算: Manages waypoints: add/del/list/toggle/clear, coords shows nether/overworld conversion
一键关闭全部战斗、移动、世界、玩家与渲染模块；带 all 时连客户端/HUD 模: Turns off every combat, movement, world, player and render module; "all" also turns off client/HUD modules
